Private Function TableName(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal wanted As String) As String
    Dim t As ListObject
    ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = "x"
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "h1": ws.Range("B1").Value = "h2"
    Set t = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
    t.Name = wanted
    TableName = CStr(t.Name = wanted)
    t.Delete
End Function

Private Function Typed(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal text As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String, v As Variant
    ws.Range("D1").Value = text
    v = ws.Range("D1").Value
    For i = 1 To Len(CStr(v))
        s = s & Hex(AscW(Mid(CStr(v), i, 1))) & " "
    Next
    Typed = TypeName(v) & " " & Trim(s) & " prefix:" & Hex(AscW(ws.Range("D1").PrefixCharacter & " "))
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = CStr(AscW(ChrW(&HFF11)))
    Case 1
        Tried = CStr(AscW(ChrW(&H5B9F)))
    Case 2
        Tried = TypeName(AscW(ChrW(&HFF11)))
    Case 3
        Tried = CStr(IsNumeric(Empty))
    Case 4
        Tried = CStr(Val(ChrW(&HFF11) & ChrW(&HFF12)))
    Case 5
        Tried = CStr(IsNumeric("$1,200"))
    Case 6
        Tried = CStr(IsNumeric("(12)"))
    Case 7
        Tried = CStr(CDec("1,200"))
    Case 8
        Tried = CStr(CDbl("1,200"))
    Case 9
        Tried = CStr(DateSerial(2026, 1, 5))
    Case 10
        Tried = Format(DateSerial(2026, 10, 28), "ggge")
    Case 11
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&H3042), ChrW(&H30A2), vbTextCompare))
    Case 12
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF21), "a", vbTextCompare))
    Case 13
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF21), "A", vbBinaryCompare))
    Case 14
        Tried = TableName(ws, ChrW(&H660E) & ChrW(&H7D30))
    Case 15
        Tried = TableName(ws, "Caf" & ChrW(&HE9))
    Case 16
        Tried = Typed(ws, "'AB")
    Case 17
        Tried = Typed(ws, ChrW(&HFF07) & "AB")
    Case 18
        Tried = Typed(ws, ChrW(&H2019) & "AB")
    Case 19
        Tried = Typed(ws, ChrW(&HFF08) & ChrW(&HFF11) & ChrW(&HFF12) & ChrW(&HFF09))
    Case 20
        Tried = Typed(ws, ChrW(&HFF11) & ChrW(&HFF12) & ChrW(&HFF05))
    Case 21
        Tried = Typed(ws, ChrW(&HFF34) & ChrW(&HFF32) & ChrW(&HFF35) & ChrW(&HFF25))
    Case 22
        Tried = CStr(Val("1" & ChrW(&HFF11) & "2"))
    Case 23
        Tried = CStr(Val("inf"))
    Case 24
        Tried = CStr(Val("nan"))
    Case 25
        Tried = CStr(Val("1_000"))
    Case 26
        Tried = CStr(Val("1d2"))
    Case 27
        Tried = CStr(Val("1e"))
    Case 28
        Tried = CStr(Val("1.5.5"))
    Case 29
        Tried = CStr(Val("-.5e1x"))
    Case 30
        Tried = CStr(Val("+ 1 2"))
    Case 31
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF71), ChrW(&H30A2), vbTextCompare))
    Case 32
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF76) & ChrW(&HFF9E), ChrW(&H30AC), vbTextCompare))
    Case 33
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF76) & ChrW(&HFF9E), ChrW(&H30AB), vbTextCompare))
    Case 34
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&H3000), " ", vbTextCompare))
    Case 35
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF41), "b", vbTextCompare))
    Case 36
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF42), "a", vbTextCompare))
    Case 37
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&H3042), ChrW(&H30A4), vbTextCompare))
    Case 38
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&H30A4), ChrW(&H3042), vbTextCompare))
    Case 39
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF11) & ChrW(&HFF10), "9", vbTextCompare))
    Case 40
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&H3094), ChrW(&H30F4), vbTextCompare))
    Case 41
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF61), ChrW(&H3002), vbTextCompare))
    Case 42
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF70), ChrW(&H30FC), vbTextCompare))
    Case 43
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFF3C), "\", vbTextCompare))
    Case 44
        Tried = CStr(StrComp(ChrW(&HFFE5), ChrW(&HA5), vbTextCompare))
    Case 45
        Tried = CStr(InStr(1, "ab" & ChrW(&HFF23), "c", vbTextCompare))
    Case 46
        Tried = CStr(InStr(1, "x" & ChrW(&H3042) & "y", ChrW(&H30A2), vbTextCompare))
    Case 47
        Tried = TableName(ws, ChrW(&H660E) & ChrW(&H7D30) & "2")
    Case 48
        Tried = TableName(ws, "1abc")
    Case 49
        Tried = TableName(ws, "a b")
    Case 50
        Tried = TableName(ws, "R1C1")
    Case 51
        Tried = TableName(ws, "Tab.le")
    Case 52
        Tried = TableName(ws, "_x")
    Case 53
        Tried = TableName(ws, ChrW(&HFF41) & "x")
    End Select
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long, wb As Workbook
    For i = 0 To 53
        Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i, wb.Worksheets(1))
        wb.Close False
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
